n9a39e61261.headline: China told it faces 'fork in the road' as officials meet CEOs
n9a39e61261.summary: IMF Managing Director Kristalina Georgieva said China must reinvent its economic policies to speed resolution of its property crisis and boost domestic consumption and productivity. She described China as at a fork in the road.
n9a39e61261.why: The IMF monitors global economic health and its assessments of China influence views on the world's second-largest economy and its trading partners.
